title: The Rise of the Gentry & Theatre

flashcard_questions.q: The belief that God had ordered all of creation in a fixed hierarchy, from the monarch at the top to the poorest at the bottom.
A system where the monarch gave jobs, titles, or land to loyal supporters in return for their service.
Who rose from the lower gentry through four marriages to become the richest woman in England after the Queen?
Which theatre, built in 1599 on the south bank of the Thames, held about 3,000 people?
Who built the first purpose-built playhouse in England in 1576?
